source: Same native XY in ct-mid-raw.png, forward-raw.png, reverse-raw.png and comparison.png. Fixed grayscale 0–255, no rescaling.
forward: Diffuse local islands and occasional short bright bands. No uniquely traceable sequence of separate strokes or rows.
reverse: Broader connected bright regions, including lower-left and centre. Their boundaries are diffuse, widths vary, and they do not define a uniquely traceable text row.
ct_relation: The native centre layer shows fibre texture, holes, and diagonal dark bands. Some reverse bright areas lie next to the lower-left dark band, while some bright areas extend across relatively brighter CT and some dark holes have weaker scores. The comparison does not establish a physical crack mechanism or ink.
independent_review: Lead inspected the original-size fixed comparison separately. The lead also found no uniquely identifiable separate strokes or rows, and left the relation to cracks unconfirmed.
next_action_within_this_experiment: Close this fixed two-order pilot without a depth or model sweep.
